searchText: MSRP $171,900. New 2027 East to West Alita 23TK Luxury Class C RV. Features Alita Value Package Nordic Slate Full Body Paint Roof Mounted 12V Solar Panel-Includes 2nd Battery Theater Seats More About This RV Meet the 2027 East to West Alita 23TK, a nimble 26-foot Class C motorhome that proves you don't need a big footprint to travel big. Built on the all-wheel-drive Ford Transit chassis with a rear and sideview camera system and an Apple CarPlay/Android Auto-ready dash, the Alita drives with confidence in any season — and the Arctic Package with 12-volt tank heaters, enclosed construction, and a 15,000 BTU ducted A/C with heat pump means the adventure doesn't stop when the weather turns. Inside, twin beds convert to a roomy king, while the 60' x 80' cabover bunk gives the grandkids (or the gear) a place of their own. The well-appointed galley features solid surface countertops with an extension, a premium subway tile backsplash, a 12-volt refrigerator, convection microwave, and portable induction cooktop, and the on-demand tankless water heater keeps hot showers coming. Azdel composite sidewalls, a one-piece automotive-painted fiberglass front cap, and a TPO roof with a limited lifetime warranty deliver lasting quality, while the 4,000-watt generator, 200-watt solar package with dual batteries, and inverter prep keep you powered wherever the road ends. Add the legless Girard power awning with LED lighting, panoramic frameless windows, swivel cab seats, and a 4,000-lb. tow capacity for your boat or toys, and the Alita 23TK is the go-anywhere, do-everything coach you've been waiting for.
